rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: PyDESeq2 Wald with apeglm-style lfc_shrink, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, an explicit control reference level and lesional-vs-control contrast, median-of-ratios inside the model, and a minimal filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) tied to the smaller group size. QC is concrete and design-specific: library sizes, blinded log1p/size-factor PCA on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, and an evidence-based retention policy for sample_01 rather than a default drop. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the Wald stat, Hallmark 2026.1 named, 15-500 window, tested-gene universe; the only gap is that a fixed seed is not stated in the GSEA step itself (deferred to the report record), and the design formula is described rather than written as ~condition. Report step covers methods, versions, thresholds, counts, diagnostics, and caveats fully, all in Python with no R.
